description: Detects silent changes to coding-agent configs (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode), flags risky ones such as new hooks, plugins and MCP servers, and lets you accept or revert them.
view.welcome:
No baseline yet. Agent Config Guard records the current state of your coding-agent configs, then tells you when something changes them.
Contents are stored only on this computer.
[Create baseline](command:agentConfigGuard.createBaseline)
config.pollIntervalSeconds: Seconds between full re-checks, as a fallback for missed file events. `0` turns polling off.
config.autoAcceptLowRisk: Accept low-risk changes (for example a model or theme switch) automatically. They are still written to the change log.
